gaps.description: Missing adversarial test coverage for path traversal, symlink escape, malformed diffs, CRLF handling, duplicate patches, stale approvals
gaps.resolution: Added 16+ adversarial tests in TestAdversarialPatchSecurity, plus 15+ adversarial tests for validation loop and progress detection across all three test files. All 176 tests pass.

gaps.description: Security: Windows absolute path (C:\, D:\) not blocked in FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS
gaps.resolution: Added r"^[A-Za-z]:" pattern to FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS. Added test_windows_absolute_path_rejected, test_windows_drive_letter_rejected.

gaps.description: Security: Windows ..\..\ traversal not blocked in FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS
gaps.resolution: Added r"\.\.[\\/]" pattern to FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS. Added symlink escape checks for backslash paths. Added test_windows_backslash_traversal_rejected.

gaps.description: Security: ^/ pattern in FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS was dead code — lstrip('/') removed leading / before checking
gaps.resolution: Restructured _check_path_confinement to check original path (before lstrip) first, then clean path. Now /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow are caught by ^/ pattern.

gaps.description: Bug: _check_line_endings never fired for mixed CRLF+LF content because has_lf_only was always False when CRLF present
gaps.resolution: Replaced with count-based logic: crlf_count > 0 and lf_only_count > 0 triggers the warning.

gaps.description: Security: parse_unified_diff had no null byte rejection — binary content could bypass safety checks
gaps.resolution: Added null byte check (\x00) returning None from parse_unified_diff.

gaps.description: Security: Malformed @@ hunk headers (non-numeric ranges, missing second range, corrupt markers) could crash parser via int()
gaps.resolution: Wrapped @@ parsing in try/except (ValueError, IndexError). Added 'len(parts) >= 2' guard for missing ranges.

gaps.description: Ledger entry_checksum was not computed (defaulted to "")
gaps.resolution: Compute SHA-256 of serialized ledger fields in apply_patch. Verified by test_ledger_entry_checksum_is_computed.

gaps.description: Missing G11 TTL (time-based expiry) protection — approved gates never auto-expired
gaps.resolution: Added G11_GATE_TTL_SECONDS=86400 and TTL check in verify_gate_for_transition. Added test_verify_expired_gate_with_ttl_check.

gaps.description: G07 event types and route registration not present in contracts/router
gaps.resolution: Added G07 WorkflowEventType entries and patches_router registration.

planned_files.backend/app/domain/patch.py: Patch domain models and unified diff parser (fixed: null bytes, malformed @@ parsing)
planned_files.backend/app/domain/repair_validation.py: Repair validation, preflight and G11 domain models
planned_files.backend/app/services/patch_apply_service: PatchSafetyService and PatchApplyService (fixed: path confinement, line endings, entry checksum)
planned_files.backend/app/services/repair_validation_s: Preflight validator, G11 gate (added TTL), validation orchestrator
planned_files.backend/app/api/routes/patches.py: G07 API routes for apply, validate, G11, chain recovery
planned_files.frontend/src/api/patches.ts: Frontend API client for G07 endpoints
